Description: A grease trap (also known as grease interceptor, grease recovery device, grease capsule and grease converter) is a plumbing device (a type of trap) designed to intercept most greases and solids before they enter a wastewater disposal system. Common wastewater contains small amounts of oils which enter into septic tanks and treatment facilities to form a floating scum layer. This scum layer is very slowly digested and broken down by microorganisms in the anaerobic digestion process. Large amounts of oil from food preparation in restaurants can overwhelm a septic tank or treatment facility, causing the release of untreated sewage into the environment. High-viscosity fats and cooking grease such as lard solidify when cooled, and can combine with other disposed solids to block drain pipes.

Name: Stainless Steel Tong
Short description:
Stainless steel tongs are a type of kitchen utensil used for gripping and picking up food items such as meat, vegetables, and fruits. They are typically made from high-quality stainless steel, which makes them durable, resistant to rust, and easy to clean.

Stainless steel tongs are designed with two arms that are connected at one end and have a spring mechanism at the other end, which allows them to be opened and closed with ease. The arms are typically long and slender, with slightly curved ends that provide a secure grip on the food item.

These tongs are commonly used in various food preparation tasks such as grilling, baking, and frying. They are ideal for flipping and turning foods, as well as serving and plating dishes. Some models may also feature non-slip handles for improved comfort and control.

Overall, stainless steel tongs are a versatile and essential tool in any kitchen, providing a safe and hygienic way to handle and serve food items.

Name: Stainless Steel Stock Pot Stove
Short description:
A stainless steel stock pot stove is a cooking appliance specifically designed for preparing large quantities of food in a stock pot. It is typically made of durable stainless steel, which offers excellent heat distribution and retention properties. The stove is built with a wide and flat cooking surface that can accommodate stock pots of various sizes.

The stainless steel construction ensures durability, resistance to rust, and easy maintenance. The stove may feature a reinforced base or bottom with multiple layers for even heat distribution and prevention of hot spots. This design helps to prevent food from burning or sticking to the pot's bottom.

The stove is equipped with one or more powerful gas burners or electric heating elements, depending on the model. These heat sources can be controlled individually, allowing for precise temperature adjustments during cooking. The burners or heating elements are typically placed beneath the cooking surface and can generate high heat levels to bring large quantities of liquid to a boil quickly.

Some stainless steel stock pot stoves may include additional features such as temperature control knobs, timers, and safety mechanisms like automatic shut-off systems. These features enhance the functionality and safety of the appliance.

Overall, a stainless steel stock pot stove is a robust and efficient cooking appliance designed for professional kitchens, catering services, or home cooks who frequently prepare large batches of soups, stocks, stews, or boil seafood and pasta. Its sturdy construction, heat distribution capabilities, and powerful burners make it ideal for handling large pots and providing consistent heat for extended cooking periods.

Name: S.S. Dispenser
Short description:
Introducing Moon Steel Fabricators' Wall-Mounted Glove Dispenser—an efficient solution for organizing and storing disposable gloves and various PPE supplies in medical, pharmaceutical, food service, and industrial settings. This dispenser, designed for cleanliness and convenience, is versatile, space-efficient, and compatible with cleanroom environments. Key Features:
  • BioSafe® Design: The dispenser's BioSafe® design eliminates hard-to-clean cracks and crevices, simplifying the sterilization process. Cut-away seams prevent germs from colonizing and particles from aggregating, ensuring easy and effective cleaning.
  • Multi-Chamber Models: Available in multi-chamber models, the dispenser organizes different sizes and types of gloves and apparel, providing a tailored solution for various needs.
  • Compatibility: Compatible with a wide range of garments, including gloves, hair nets, shoe covers, booties, and face masks, the dispenser promotes efficient gowning protocols.
  • Space-Efficient Gravity-Fed Design: The gravity-fed self-dispensing design is ideal for high-traffic operations. Vertical slots allow easy visibility of remaining supplies, prompting timely refills. This design minimizes clutter and reinforces proper glove usage.
  • Durable Stainless Steel Construction: Crafted from durable stainless steel, the dispenser is suitable for sterile and ESD-safe applications. Choose between 304 or 316-grade stainless steel based on specific environmental needs.
  • Enhanced Corrosion Resistance: The 304 or 316-grade stainless steel options contain higher levels of nickel and molybdenum, enhancing corrosion resistance in wet environments and protecting against degradation from harsh biocides like bleach-based disinfectants.
Dispenser Design Details:
  • Smooth Beveled Slots: Dispenser slots feature smooth, beveled edges to prevent snags and tears, safeguarding dispensed materials from damage.
  • Bottom Basin: A bottom basin catches loose materials, preventing them from falling to the floor and maintaining a tidy workspace.
  • Clean Pivot Lid: The clean pivot lid eliminates difficult-to-clean crevices associated with conventional piano-style hinges. The sloped top reduces particle accumulation.
  • Covered Keyhole Slots: Covered keyhole slots facilitate easy wall mounting while preventing dust or particles from entering the dispenser. This design also minimizes the risk of apparel snagging on wall-mounting hardware.
